name: routific
description: Optimize delivery routes and manage orders, routes, and schedules through the Routific MCP server.

publication.release_notes: First stable release. Optimize delivery routes in chat or in your Routific account, manage orders, routes, and schedules, and get a guided first-run setup when you connect the plugin.

interface.longDescription: Connect to Routific to optimize routes in chat or manage orders, routes, and schedules in your Routific account. Account operations use the server’s sign-in flow.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me optimize my delivery routes with Routific.

positive.description: Optimize a single-driver route in chat with no account (automatic geocoding, single-vehicle sequencing).
positive.prompt: Just tell me here in chat - don't set up an account. I have one driver starting at 1 Ferry Building, San Francisco, CA 94111. What's the best order to visit these 5 stops: 865 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103; 151 3rd St, San Francisco, CA 94103; 900 North Point St, San Francisco, CA 94109; 1 Dr Carlton B Goodlett Pl, San Francisco, CA 94102; 3601 Lyon St, San Francisco, CA 94123.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the optimal stop order with a per-stop ETA and driving distance, plus total travel time and distance, as a plain-language itinerary in chat. No link, nothing saved to any account.

positive.description: Optimize multiple vehicles with time-window and ordering constraints in chat (requires sign-in; nothing saved).
positive.prompt: Keep this in chat. Plan 2 drivers, both starting and ending at 1 Ferry Building, San Francisco, CA 94111, each working 9:00 AM-5:00 PM. Stops: 865 Market St; 151 3rd St; 900 North Point St; 1 Dr Carlton B Goodlett Pl; 3601 Lyon St; 2 Marina Blvd; 1000 Great Hwy; 3250 24th St; 199 Museum Way; 601 Van Ness Ave - all San Francisco, CA. The stop at 199 Museum Way must be visited before noon.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a solved plan in chat: each vehicle's stops in order with ETAs, respecting the shift windows and the before-noon constraint, plus any unscheduled stops. Nothing is saved to the user's workspace.

positive.description: Set up a plan on the map in the user's Routific account for dispatch (one-call map path).
positive.prompt: Set this up in my Routific account so I can see it on a map and send it to my driver's phone. For tomorrow, one driver starting at 1 Ferry Building, San Francisco, CA 94111. Stops: 865 Market St; 151 3rd St; 900 North Point St; 1 Dr Carlton B Goodlett Pl; 3601 Lyon St - all San Francisco, CA.
positive.expected_behavior: Reply leads with a bold 'Open in Routific' link (view_in_app) followed by a short summary (date, number of stops and routes, anything unscheduled). The stops are added as orders and a route is created and optimized in the account. No stop-by-stop list or ETAs in chat.

positive.description: Edit a day's orders after planning - apply one change to all of the day's stops. (Run the show_on_map case first; use that date.)
positive.prompt: For tomorrow's route, add the note "Call customer on arrival" to every stop.
positive.expected_behavior: Applies the note to all of the day's orders in one bulk call and confirms they were updated, in plain language.

positive.description: Review a planned route's timeline (read-only). (Run the show_on_map case first; use that date.)
positive.prompt: Show me my driver's schedule for tomorrow - the stops in order with their arrival times.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the route's stops in visiting order with each stop's ETA, in plain language. Read-only - nothing is created or changed.

negative.description: Point-to-point navigation is a consumer maps task, not fleet route optimization - the plugin should not trigger.
negative.prompt: What's the fastest driving route from 1 Ferry Building, San Francisco to SFO airport right now, and how long will it take with traffic?

negative.description: Consumer package tracking overlaps the word 'order' but is not delivery planning in a Routific account - the plugin should not trigger.
negative.prompt: Where is my order? I'm expecting a package from Amazon today and want to know when it'll arrive at my house.

negative.description: Personal transit/commute planning has no fleet, drivers, or delivery stops to optimize - the plugin should not trigger.
negative.prompt: What's the best route to get to work by train tomorrow morning if I need to be downtown by 9am?
